behavior_constraints: numsim matinfo --input <mtx_file> reads a Matrix Market sparse matrix and prints analysis to stdout
Output exactly 9 lines in order: rows, cols, nnz, symmetric, bandwidth, frobenius_norm, diagonal_dominance, max_abs_value, min_abs_nonzero
nnz reports full-matrix count: for MM-declared symmetric files, each off-diagonal stored entry counts as two; diagonal entries count once

symmetric is yes for MM-declared symmetric matrices; for general format, explicitly check every (i,j,v) has matching (j,i,v') with |v-v'| < 1e-12*max(|v|,|v'|,1e-30); rectangular matrices are not symmetric
bandwidth is max |i-j| over all nonzero entries in the full matrix
frobenius_norm is sqrt(sum of a_ij^2) over all full-matrix entries; for symmetric matrices off-diagonal entries appear twice in the sum
diagonal_dominance is strict if |a_ii| > sum_{j!=i} |a_ij| for every row, weak if >= for every row but not strict, none otherwise; rows with no diagonal entry treat a_ii=0
max_abs_value, min_abs_nonzero, and frobenius_norm are printed in scientific notation
If the input file cannot be read, print 'error: cannot read matrix file' to stderr and exit with code 1
All existing commands must continue to work unchanged
entities.summary: Add a numsim matinfo command that reads a Matrix Market sparse matrix and prints rows, cols, nnz, symmetry, bandwidth, Frobenius norm, diagonal dominance, and extreme value statistics.

instruction_head:
Add a `numsim matinfo` command that reads a sparse matrix in Matrix Market format and prints analysis of its properties. All existing commands must continue to work unchanged.

## CLI

```
numsim matinfo --input <mtx_file>
```

## Output

Print to stdout, one property per line:

```
rows: <n>
cols: <m>
nnz: <count>
symmetric: <yes|no>
bandwidth: <b>
frobenius_norm: <value in scientific notation>
diagonal_dominance: <strict|weak|none>
max_abs_value: <value in scientific notation>
min_abs_nonzero:
